newsitem.title: USA: Tyco Intl to acquire ElectroStar.
newsitem.headline: Tyco Intl to acquire ElectroStar.

text.p: Tyco International Ltd, an industrial and commerical products manufacturer, said Friday it had agreed to acquire ElectroStar Inc, a printed circuit board maker, for $14 a share, or about $106 million cash.
Tyco said the deal will make an "immediate positive" contribution to its earnings.
It said it will launch a tender ofer to puchase ElectroStar's 7.5 million shares. The offer will be followed by a merger in which each remaining ElectroStar share will be exchanged for $14 cash.
"ElectroStar is an excellant fit with Tyco's printed circuit board group," said Tyco Chairman L. Dennis Kozlowski.
"The two groups have complimentary products that will allow us to expand into rapidly growing market segments and enlarge our mutual customer base."
Logan, Utah-based ElectroStar has annual revenues of about $70 million. Tyco's revenues are more than $6 billion.
The deal is subject to the tender of a majority of outstanding ElectroStar shares and other conditions, Tyco said.
